summary: Both backend and frontend tested against the fully-cloned Convex app (deployment fearless-ostrich-878). Backend regression on Convex REST .site surface = 63/63 pass (test_iteration11_convex_rest.py), and a NEW security suite = 11/11 pass (test_iteration12_security.py) confirming edge:createSession, migrate:* and bridge:* are NOT publicly callable on the Convex /api/mutation endpoint while the public OAuth action edge:exchangeSession and public queries remain reachable. FastAPI stub /api/health returns {ok:true} and / returns backend=convex, mongodb=false. Frontend web preview: login screen renders correctly. localStorage session_token injection: OWNER -> /owner renders live Convex KPIs (sales 2,409 / collections 200 / debts 2,076 etc, leaderboard, debt list), ACCOUNTANT (test_token_acct) -> /acct renders accountant dashboard, DEVELOPER (test_token_dev) -> /dev renders developer console with live Convex data. ONE CRITICAL ROUTING BUG: FIELD_AGENT (test_token_agent / test_token_agent2) is redirected to /dist which renders 'Unmatched Route - Page could not be found' because the entire app/dist/ Expo Router group is MISSING from the repository (homeFor() in src/auth.tsx:178 returns 'dist' for field agents but there is no app/dist/_layout.tsx). This is the exact same regression previously fixed in iteration 9 (see PRD.md lines 61-68) and was lost in the recent repo clone/Convex-restore. Fix is to re-add app/dist/_layout.tsx (RoleTabs with 4 tabs: index/sale/customers/ops) mirroring app/owner/_layout.tsx. All backend data and auth are healthy; only the field-agent route group needs to be re-added by the main agent.

Developer email is no longer in the codebase (set via Convex env DEVELOPER_EMAILS as requested). test_token_dev resolves to role=DEVELOPER from Convex session row only.

Security: Convex /api/mutation POSTs for edge:createSession, migrate:importUsers/importOrgs/importAll/run/verify and bridge:upsert/insertRow/removeByKey all return 'Could not find public function' as expected. Public action edge:exchangeSession and public queries still resolve. Good lockdown.

rca_of_issue: FIELD_AGENT Unmatched Route — ROOT CAUSE: `src/auth.tsx::homeFor` returns the string 'dist' for role=EMPLOYEE / employee_type=FIELD_AGENT (line 178), and app/_layout.tsx issues `router.replace('/dist')` on auth. Expo Router then looks up `app/dist/_layout.tsx` or `app/dist/index.tsx` — neither exists after the latest clone/restore (`ls /app/frontend/app/` shows acct, dev, owner but NOT dist), so the +not-found screen renders. The identical bug was previously reported and fixed in iteration 9 (PRD.md:61-68) by committing an `app/dist/_layout.tsx` with a RoleTabs group of 4 tabs; that commit was lost during the Convex-era repo clone. REPRO: set localStorage session_token to 'test_token_agent' and reload preview. MITIGATION: re-add app/dist/_layout.tsx mirroring the owner/acct layouts; the underlying DistributorOps / NewSale / Customers / Overview screens still exist under src/screens/ and are wired, only the route container is missing.
